column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-COVERAGE-2.md item 3. Zero findings in the library or the handlers. The package's existing FuzzWebAuthnCredentialResponse only reaches the parse; the attestation statement of every format (packed, tpm, android-key, android-safetynet, fido-u2f, apple, compound) is decoded only in CreateCredential, so it was never fuzzed. New targets ceremony_fuzz_test.go:FuzzWebAuthnRegistrationCeremony (parse+CreateCredential) and :FuzzWebAuthnAssertionCeremony (parse+ValidateLogin with an independent ECDSA oracle), seeded with real signed ceremonies for a fixed RP/challenge/key (TestCeremonySeeds_AreAcceptedByTheLibrary proves the seeds pass verification); registered in scripts/fuzzing/targets.d. Ran 4m+4m+3m locally: 9.1M/7.0M/2.0M execs, no crasher. malformed_test.go:TestCeremonyMalformedInputs_Refused pins 21 shapes (authData <37 bytes, AT without data, credential ID length 0xFFFF and 1024, truncated COSE key, trailing bytes, duplicate fmt/authData CBOR keys, indefinite-length map, nesting >5, non-map attestationObject, none with attStmt; assertion with truncated/extended authData, foreign or truncated signature, wrong type, foreign userHandle). Holding: webauthncbor DupMapKeyEnforcedAPF, MaxNestedLevels 5, IndefLength/Tags forbidden; authData min 37 and credential ID max 1023; handler body capped at 64 KiB (maxWebAuthnBody, LimitReader). Not covered: duplicate JSON keys in clientDataJSON (encoding/json last-wins; the client data is produced by the user's own browser and signed as raw bytes, so no relying-party differential); metadata-service attestation trust (not configured)
